text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking a break in the cafeteria,
when...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Hehehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okay, the cream is done, and the height
looks
perfect too! Our ginormous
wedding cake turned
out splendidly! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In front of Hishi Akebono stands a large
wedding
cake which towers over even
her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wanted to throw a party for me
and the
other muses. We ran in wedding
dresses, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Our schedules have been a bit busy, so
we
haven't had a chance to actually
celebrate all our
hard work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her explanation makes sense, but I'm
still curious
about the huge number of
cardboard boxes lined
up next to the
cake.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
These? They're American-grown
cherries! They're
my absolute favorite!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
They're big, juicy, and incredibly sweet!
Once I
start eating them, I just can't
stop!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to use a whole bunch to top
the cake!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course! ♪ I want everyone to enjoy
them!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Akebono! The muses have arrived!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay, coming! Thanks, Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you should come along and eat up
too. I still
owe you one for that the trip
to the farm. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I gladly accept and head to the party.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay, everyone! Go ahead and dig in!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Mmm! It's a culinary masterpiece! This cake tastes even more incredible than it looks!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, try the cherry part too! You'll love
it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
They're so sweet and juicy! Have you all
tasted
the cherries?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Not yet. But the layers of sponge cake
and cream
have wowed me enough
already...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then you've gotta give it a try! ♪ I'll
cut you a
slice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, um, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You look like you're in bliss, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh, ah! I just...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Worry not, I know how you feel. This
cake is truly
one of a kind.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm so happy! It's just so buono that

everyone's enjoying this wonderful meal

together! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I always feel buono when I eat
them, so I
want everyone to enjoy them
and be buono
too! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Happiness grows the more you share it!
And
happiness is buono, buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So, please, you have some too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My piece is so large it barely fits on the
plate. I
take a giant bite, and as the
cake fills my
cheeks...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a wonderful expression you
have!
Now you know what it means to be
buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Go on, take some more! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Open up! Say "Ahhh!" Come on, a little
bit more.
Ahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find myself somewhat flustered by Hishi

Akebono's efforts to stuff my face with
cake, but
I have a great time anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I move to take the cake when...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Why, hello there, my beautiful angels! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Beauty Anshinzawa?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a scrumptious-looking cake!
Those
dark red toppings look utterly
enticing. I feel
inspired all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
But I come with a fair warning... An
occasional
treat is one thing, but
remember—moderation is a
thing of
B.E.A.U.T.Y.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Truuue! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the meal, the muses engage in
some intense
training to burn off the
excess calories...
